prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1375; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was changing lanes on a multi-lane road in Baytown, Texas, checking my mirror and signaling first, when a car in the next lane moved over and clipped the side of my vehicle. Both cars were pulled toward the shoulder, and the other driver left the scene before I could get a full exchange of information. I have described what happened the same way every time I have spoken about it, whether to the officer, to my insurer, or to the medical staff. My knee struck the door frame on impact, and I have had pain and swelling since. I am the policyholder's household member and was driving the family car with permission, so I am asking that this claim be considered under that coverage.
